title: TV clip of a UFO turning away from a beam in space

tellings.quote: On TV. Uh there's a a clip that they show on TV every now and then of this UFO that's coming in and a beam goes like that and the thing turns around and leaves

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, tells the podcast host Jesse Michels about a clip he says is shown on TV now and then. In it, he says, a UFO is coming in from space, a beam shoots out, and the object turns around and leaves, which he takes as a sign that something was being fended off.
